title: Marathon Tempo Run with Strength Circuit

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Move slowly through full range of motion, focus on spinal mobility. Inhale on cow, exhale on cat.

items.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
items.cues: Control the switch between positions, maintaining upright posture. This opens up hip mobility for running.

items.name: Butt Kicks
items.cues: Kick heels toward glutes at a moderate pace to activate hip flexors and prepare for tempo work.

items.name: Agility Ladder Run
items.cues: Quick feet through the ladder, maintain forward momentum. Focus on cadence and coordination.

items.name: Tempo Run
items.cues: Run at RPE 7-8 (comfortably hard pace). Maintain steady breathing, relaxed shoulders. This is marathon-race pace building for your 92-day goal.

items.name: Back Squat
items.cues: Drive through heels, keep chest upright, controlled descent. Build lower body power for running economy.

items.name: Bent Over Row
items.cues: Hinge at hips, pull elbows high, squeeze shoulder blades together. Strengthen posterior chain for running posture.

items.name: Calf Stretch
items.cues: Hold stretch against wall, keep heel down. Release tension from active running muscles.

items.name: Biceps Wall Stretch
items.cues: Place arm on wall at shoulder height, gently rotate body away. Open front shoulders and chest.

items.name: Bird Dog
items.cues: Extend opposite arm and leg, maintain level hips. Stabilize core and decompress spine after tempo effort.

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Slow, controlled movements. Focus on deep breathing to activate parasympathetic nervous system.

rationale: Tempo run format matches marathon training goal with 92 days until race - this session builds lactate threshold and race-specific pacing at RPE 7-8
Included post-run strength work (squats and rows) to build lower body power and posterior chain resilience for long-distance running economy

Extended rest from training (999 days) requires gradual reintroduction, so strength sets focus on moderate volume with 3x8 reps rather than high intensity, while tempo run duration is sustainable at 25 minutes
